scenario: 今天的基础设施赛道大多在算推理服务的细账。投机解码有两篇：HybridSpec 发现 GDN 和 MoE 混合的模型验证成本涨得特别快，另一篇提醒投机解码可能悄悄改变带约束生成的输出。FlagRot 让 KV cache 里每个 K 向量的每一小段自己决定要不要旋转，GC-MoE 和 EpiLoRA 分别把 MoE 的通信和 LoRA 的计算藏进主计算里。训练这边，LEAP 在任务提交前预测它在每种加速卡上的吞吐，用来选卡。

papers.title: Look Before You Launch: Learned Throughput Prediction for Hardware Selection in a Production Training Fleet
papers.authors: Hossein Askari, Wei Sun, Chenguang Zhu, Bin Zan, Sreen Tallam, Keyu Man
papers.abstract: In mixed-vendor accelerator fleets, many training jobs can run on several hardware types, and the best choice depends on each job's throughput on each type. Routing a job needs a throughput estimate for every candidate type before the job runs. We present LEAP, a machine learning performance prediction service that predicts each training job's throughput on every candidate hardware type at submission time and ranks the candidates by predicted throughput per unit cost. It routes tens of thousands of training job attempts a day across hundreds of different model types and more than 20 hardware types in a production fleet. LEAP predicts throughput from submission-time training configuration, including each job's prior throughput. LEAP reaches an accuracy of 77% over 30 nightly retrains, higher than the lookup table it replaced and at least as high as every alternative model we tested, including fine-tuned language models. Over six months, the share of eligible training GPU-hours that rece
papers.summary: 同一个训练任务往往能跑在好几种加速卡上，跑在哪种上最划算，取决于它在每种卡上的吞吐。任务放错了卡照样能跑完、不报错，多花的钱没人察觉。LEAP（作者在生产机群上部署的选卡服务）在任务提交时就预测它在每种候选卡上的吞吐，再按每花一块钱能换来的吞吐给这些卡排序，每天给数万次训练任务选卡。它有 77% 的预测和实测吞吐相差不到两成。半年后，能换卡的训练 GPU 小时里有 95% 都由它排过序，作者估计因此省下约 3% 的训练算力成本。

papers.title: Modular and Efficient Approximate Nearest Neighbors Search with Vectorium and kANNolo
papers.authors: Silvio Martinico, Franco Maria Nardini, Cosimo Rulli, Rossano Venturini
papers.abstract: Approximate Nearest Neighbors (ANN) search over neural embeddings powers modern retrieval systems such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation. Embeddings come in three representations (dense, sparse and multi-vector), and efficient search combines an index structure, a similarity function and a quantization scheme. Existing libraries fix one combination, hard-code each one separately, or factor only one side of the problem, and none covers all three representations. We present Vectorium and kANNolo, two open-source Rust libraries that split this design space into a data-management layer and an indexing layer. Vectorium abstracts the vector, the distance function, the quantizer and the dataset independently, and provides 11 encoders, from 32-bit floats to sub-bit codes. On top of it, kANNolo implements Hierarchical Navigable Small-World (HNSW) graph and Inverted Vector File (IVF) indexes that are generic over representation, encoder and metric, and a two-stage index that composes any first-s
papers.summary: 做向量检索时，换一种 embedding 形态或量化方式，往往就得换一个库。现有的 ANN 库要么只支持一种组合，要么每种组合各写一份代码，没有一个同时覆盖稠密、稀疏和多向量三种 embedding。Vectorium 和 kANNolo 是两个开源 Rust 库：前一个管向量、距离和量化，后一个在上面实现 HNSW、IVF 等索引。任意组合都在编译时生成专用代码，所以拆成模块不会拖慢运行速度。在稠密数据的 12 组对比里，它们有 9 组拿到最好的内存和吞吐权衡。同时维护稠密和稀疏检索的团队，换一种量化或索引就不必再换一个库。

papers.title: FlagRot: Selective Rotation for Low-Bit KV Caches
papers.authors: Kunming Shao, Xijie Huang, Jierun Chen, Jiaqi Shao, Yanli Wang, Jiangnan Yu, Qiwei Li, Wei Zhang, Kwang-Ting Cheng, Chi Ying Tsui
papers.abstract: Long-context inference is bound by the KV cache, which 2-bit codes could shrink about sixfold if their error stays in check. The usual remedy rotates keys before quantizing, assuming rotation always helps. However, we observe that it does not: rotation flattens a spiky piece of a key but can give a flat one a new peak, and both coexist within one key. We therefore propose FlagRot, which stores each 32-channel piece rotated or as is, whichever has the smaller calibrated attention error, and rotates the query instead when reading. We further show that how often to decide follows the quantization axis: per-channel caches such as KIVI need one decision per head, at no write cost, while per-token caches decide per key, with the choice stored in existing sign bits. At 2.5 bits per value, FlagRot lowers the twelve-model KL divergence of KIVI from 18.7 to 12.4 x 10^-3, below RotateKV on 9 of 12 models. Served as a vLLM plugin, it raises RULER at 128k tokens by +2.9 points and the LongBench v1
papers.summary: 长上下文推理的瓶颈在 KV cache，把其中的 K 向量压到很低的位宽能省下大量显存，但误差难控。常见做法是量化前先把 K 向量旋转一下，默认旋转总有好处。作者发现并非如此：旋转能把一段带尖峰的 K 向量摊平，也会让一段本来平坦的冒出新尖峰，而且两种情况常在同一个 K 向量里同时出现。FlagRot 因此把每个 K 向量切成小段，每段在校准数据上比一比：旋转和不旋转，哪种让注意力分数的误差更小，就存哪种。读取时，只把 query 里对应旋转段的那部分也转一下，乘出来的分数就和不旋转时一致。每个值平均只用 2.5 bit 时，常用的 KIVI 量化和原模型之间的 KL 散度在 FlagRot 下从 18.7 降到 12.4。这是 12 个模型上的平均结果。

papers.title: Testing Processor Contracts in Speculative Decoding Engines
papers.authors: Tianyu Ding, Yaocheng Tong, Muzhi Yang, Lei Yang, Fei Jiang
papers.abstract: Speculative sampling can accelerate decoding without changing the target distribution. Its standard guarantee assumes that logits processors, which enforce constraints or modify token scores, receive the appropriate token prefix and state at each verification position. We formalize this processor-prefix contract and present BADC (branch-aware differential conformance testing). BADC combines enumerated references on tiny random models, checks of processor inputs and state, and simultaneous confidence bounds on output-event probabilities. Preregistered, source-informed experiments on selected Transformers and llama-cpp-python releases confirm two causes: processors read unverified drafts or advance state without rollback. For one pilot-selected prompt on a trained checkpoint, fresh samples give a 60.26-percentage-point lower bound on the difference in the probability of a predefined first-token event between ordinary and prompt-lookup decoding, with nominal simultaneous 95% coverage unde
papers.summary: 投机解码号称不改变输出分布，但这个保证有个前提。语法约束、重复惩罚、水印这类组件会在采样前修改 token 分数，它们在每个验证位置拿到的前缀和状态必须是对的。作者检查了 Transformers 等推理库的部分版本，确认了两种出错方式：这类组件读到了还没验证通过的草稿 token，或者推进了内部状态，草稿被拒后却没有回滚。作者在一个训练好的模型上开了无分类器引导，选定一个 prompt，统计第一个输出 token 是否为某个事先定好的 token。普通解码和从 prompt 里找草稿的投机解码相比，这个概率至少相差 60.26 个百分点。用投机解码加速带约束的生成时，输出可能已经悄悄变了。

papers.title: What Sets the Serving Speed of Looped Language Models? Measurements and Optimizations Graded by Exactness
papers.authors: Dezhen Lu, Runguo Li, Zixiang Ni, Yuchen Tang, Xingquan Kong, Jiaxing Yang, Jiarui Guo, Lingxiang Gao
papers.abstract: Looped language models apply one block of layers many times per token, so a serving engine pays every per-layer overhead once per loop; we measure serving for Ouro and Huginn-0125 in an open-source looped-model engine and grade our optimizations from bitwise-identical changes to those that require an accuracy check. At batch 1, fusing all loop submissions leaves Ouro throughput at 0.99x; the 5689 small kernels per token are the real cost, and fusing them behind rounding fences raises throughput 1.11-1.59x while 1014/1014 requests remain identical. An approximate fusion is no faster and misses a one-point GSM8K rule on 87 questions (61 and 62 correct versus 64), so we do not ship it. Huginn's released defaults avoid dead KV slots, reuse prefix-cache pages, and serve 1.77-3.16x faster than the base engine; Ouro reaches 1.65-2.15x and agent sessions 1.91-3.21x, while Huginn's noise and prefix-reuse changes stay within one point on all 1319 Huginn test questions; Huginn's packed prefill, -
papers.summary: 循环语言模型每生成一个 token，都要把同一组层重复跑好几遍，推理引擎里每层的固定开销也就跟着成倍增加。作者在一个开源的循环模型推理引擎上测了 Ouro 和 Huginn 两个模型。单请求时，把每轮循环各提交一次的 CUDA Graph 合成一次提交，吞吐几乎不变。真正的开销是 Ouro 每个 token 要跑的 5689 个小 kernel。把这些小 kernel 融合起来，同时保证输出逐位不变，吞吐提高到原来的 1.11 到 1.59 倍。作者按是否逐位一致给每项优化分级：一种近似融合没有更快，还在 GSM8K 上少答对了几道题，所以没有采用。

papers.title: HybridSpec: Throughput-Aware Speculative Decoding for Hybrid GDN-MoE Models
papers.authors: Haiyu Wang, Sai Qian Zhang, Zechun Liu, Steven Li
papers.abstract: In speculative decoding, parallel drafters such as DFlash make drafting cheap, so target verification dominates each round. A central choice is the verification length, the number of tokens that the target processes in each round. Verifying more draft tokens can accept more of them, but work after the first rejection is wasted. For hybrid target models that combine Gated DeltaNet (GDN) and mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers, verification time grows much faster with this length than for dense models. In a single-request profile of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B with DFlash, it grew by 71% from length 4 to 16, almost entirely in GDN and MoE layers, compared with 4%-6% for a dense Qwen3-4B target. Each GDN layer must update a recurrent state at every token and recover it at the end of the accepted prefix. The MoE cost depends on the experts that the tokens activate, which are known only once verification runs. We present HybridSpec, which selects the verification length on the GPU from draft-side acceptanc
papers.summary: 投机解码里，草稿越来越便宜，每一轮的时间主要花在目标模型验证草稿上。一次验证多少个草稿 token 是关键选择：验得多能多接受，但第一个被拒之后的计算全白做。目标模型一旦混合了 Gated DeltaNet（GDN，一种带循环状态的线性注意力层）和 MoE，这笔账就变了。在 Qwen 的一个这类模型上，验证长度从 4 加到 16，验证耗时涨了 71%，稠密模型只涨几个百分点。HybridSpec 每一轮都在 GPU 上重新选验证长度，依据是草稿 token 的预估接受率和目标模型的实测延迟。在三个这类模型上，它比 DFlash 这种并行出草稿的方法再快三成左右。

papers.title: ROCm InferaSim: Cut LLM Serving Trial Costs and Deploy the Best Configuration
papers.authors: Anshu Raina, Yao Fu, Zhang Jiejing, Peyman Razaghi, Shiksha Patel, Ravi Gupta, Deval Shah, Adeem Jassani, Subhajit Dutta Chowdhury, Lorri Rao, Kailash Gogineni, Zhenyu Gu, Onil Gunawardana, Emad Barsoum
papers.abstract: Serving an LLM efficiently depends on the engine, how the model is split across GPUs, precision, scheduler settings, speculative decoding, KV-cache management, and prefill-decode disaggregation. The best configuration depends on the model, hardware, workload, and objective. Operators usually find it by trial and error. Exhaustively measuring the candidates in our study would take about 25,000 GPU-hours. ROCm InferaSim predicts serving performance from a few short measurements. Choices such as batch size, prompt length, and GPU count change the amount of work per GPU without changing the kernels. ROCm InferaSim benchmarks each distinct set of kernels once, on at most one node. We call this measurement an anchor. Analytical laws carry that anchor to other deployments that run the same kernels. For multi-node deployments, ROCm InferaSim reduces the configuration to a single-node equivalent, measures it, and scales the result analytically. A simulator replays multi-turn traffic, and a tuni
papers.summary: 给一个大模型找最合适的推理部署配置，要选引擎、怎么切到多张 GPU、什么精度和调度参数，平时只能一个个试，每次占一到几个节点好几分钟。ROCm InferaSim 抓住了一点：batch 大小、prompt 长度、GPU 数量这类选择只改变每张卡的工作量，不改变实际跑的 kernel。所以每组不同的 kernel 只需在一个节点上实测一次，作者把这次实测叫锚点，再用解析公式推算其他配置的性能。在 AMD GPU 上，实测这些锚点花了 9.1 GPU 小时，直接测它们覆盖的配置要 204 GPU 小时。预测出的每个输出 token 耗时，中位误差是 8.1%。调参前先用预测筛掉大部分候选，能省下大部分试机成本。

papers.title: EpiLoRA: Fusing Many LoRA Adapters into Low-Precision GEMMs for Serving and RL
papers.abstract: Low-rank adapters (LoRA) let one base model serve many fine-tuned variants: multi-tenant engines keep a single copy of the base and batch the requests of many tenants, each with its own adapter. As base models move to 8-bit (FP8) and 4-bit formats, their general matrix multiplications (GEMMs) become cheaper, but the adapters do not: engines run them as separate small GPU kernels beside the GEMM, whose latency takes a growing share of every decoding step. An adapter projects its input down to a low rank and back up, and our key observation is that the GEMM needs the down-projection only in its epilogue, the final stage in which it writes its output. EpiLoRA, a plugin for the vLLM engine, therefore launches the down-projection first and the low-precision GEMM as a dependent kernel that streams its weights meanwhile and adds every tenant's up-projection in its epilogue. On NVIDIA Hopper GPUs, EpiLoRA decodes for a single adapter with up to 24% lower time per token than vLLM's fastest conf
papers.summary: 基础模型换成 FP8 或更低精度后，主矩阵乘变便宜了，LoRA 适配器却成了每步解码里越来越大的开销。多租户推理里，一份基础模型同时挂着很多租户的适配器，它们还在主矩阵乘旁边单独跑一串小 kernel。作者注意到，主矩阵乘只有在最后写出结果时，才用到 LoRA 降维那一步的输出。EpiLoRA 于是先启动降维计算，主矩阵乘同时读取权重，到写结果时，在同一个 kernel 里算出每个租户的升维结果并加上去。在 Hopper GPU 上，单个适配器解码时每个 token 的耗时比 vLLM 最快的配置低最多 24%。同样的低精度权重也能直接用来做 LoRA 强化学习，27B 的模型一张 48GB 的卡就能训。

papers.title: GC-MoE: Overlapping Expert-Parallel Token Dispatch with FP8/FP4 Grouped GEMM via CUDA Green Contexts
papers.authors: Yong Li, Kan Liu, Tao Lan
papers.abstract: Under expert parallelism, mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers pay all-to-all token dispatch, grouped GEMMs, and a combine step in every layer. In decode each rank holds only 1-256 tokens: dispatch latency and weight traffic dominate while tensor-core utilization is inherently low. In fused operators such as DeepGEMM's Mega MoE, dispatch and computation overlap only by sharing every SM: dispatch warps compete with TMA/MMA and epilogue warps for registers, shared memory, and issue slots; every phase shares one CTA resource budget, synchronization spans the whole SM array, and every replay ends with a workspace-clean pass and a cross-rank barrier. We present GC-MoE, an open-source FP8/FP4 MoE inference operator for NVIDIA Hopper and Blackwell GPUs that uses CUDA Green Contexts to split the device into a small communication partition and a large compute partition. Each role gets its own kernel, resource budget, and synchronization domain, so dispatch and GEMM tune independently. A three-node C
papers.summary: MoE 解码时，每张卡上只有几个到几百个 token，分组矩阵乘受带宽限制，本来就用不满所有 SM。可现有的融合算子仍让 token 分发和矩阵乘挤在同一批 SM 上，互相抢寄存器和共享内存。GC-MoE 用 CUDA Green Contexts 在驱动层把 GPU 切成一小块通信分区和一大块计算分区，两边各跑自己的 kernel、各自调优，第一批 token 一到，计算就能开始。在 H20 上解码 DeepSeek 的一个 MoE 模型，它比现有的 DeepGEMM 融合算子平均快 18.8%。MoE 解码时，把通信和计算分到不同的 SM 上，比让它们在同一个 SM 里抢资源更划算。

papers.title: Diagnose Distributed AI Workload Failures with NVIDIA Attribution
papers.abstract: In distributed AI workloads, a single error can produce a cascade of symptoms. A GPU or fabric event may surface as NCCL errors on other ranks, scheduler state...
papers.summary: 分布式训练里，一张 GPU 出了硬件故障，最先报错的往往是其他节点上的 NCCL。日志里的异常只说明任务在哪里停下，不说明故障从哪里开始。NVIDIA 开源了内部用了多年的故障归因系统 NVIDIA Attribution。它把一个任务相关的应用日志、系统日志、GPU 驱动消息、调度器状态和监控指标收在一起。然后按固定规则比对各个事件的先后和关联：某个节点先报 GPU 硬件错误、随后其他节点才出 NCCL 报错，就把前者判为根因，后者记为症状。最后它给出根因、受影响的节点和证据。文中的例子里，三条 NCCL 报错最终归到某个节点上的一次 NVLink 信号故障。按 NVIDIA 的说法，它每周分析数百万个任务。这样告警和修复可以直接对准出故障的机器，不被下游报错带偏。
